_doc: One precise contradiction per distinct context, for the `contradict` rung of scripts/assay-substitution.ts. See docs/SUBSTITUTION-CONTROL.md.
_design: Each entry rewrites ONE fact in the context so that it CONTRADICTS what the answers assert, rather than removing it. The context stays the same length, topic, format and block count; it stays internally coherent; only the value changes.

`cite` is the token an answer must contain to count as having relied on the altered fact. It splits the 39 cells into a cited group (should lose points) and an uncited group (should not). That split is decided offline from the frozen answers, with no human labelling.

This is the rung that FINDINGS #21 recorded as untried. It was first scoped as `one_number` and rejected for power, because only 4 of 13 queries share a numeric token between answer and context. Widening it from 'change a number' to 'contradict a stated fact' — entities, directions and conditions included — makes all 11 contexts usable.
`match` identifies the context by a string unique to it among the 11.

contradictions.note: breaks both the value and the maker=taker equality. Query 0 asserts it; query 1 answers only about futures and is the built-in control.
